units.source_text: 岛村顾虑有旁人看见，就悄悄地离开了驹子，站在一群孩子的后面。

en.t: Worried that someone might see them, Shimamura quietly moved away from Komako and stood behind a group of children.

units.source_text: 火光灼人，孩子们向后倒退了几步。

en.t: The heat of the fire was scorching, and the children stepped back a few paces.

units.source_text: 脚底下的积雪也有点松软了。

en.t: The packed snow underfoot had also grown a little soft.

units.source_text: 人墙前面的雪被水和火融化，雪地上踏着杂乱的脚印，变得泥泞不堪了。

en.t: The snow in front of the wall of people had melted from water and fire, and the trampled, crisscrossing footprints had turned the snowfield into a muddy mess.
